name: sester
description: AI agents pay and verify receipts. pay charges against an embedded local proof-chain and returns a node-cosigned receipt; verify_receipt checks a receipt independently on the receiving side with no Sester install and no node secret — the proof is recomputed with sha256. balance/history give daily spend, quota and the audit trail. Embedded mode is $0 with no keys, no testnet, no mainnet.

SESTER_MCP_SECRET.description: Ledger seal. Required in production; when empty a demo secret is used with a warning.

SESTER_MCP_NODE_SECRET.description: Node-cosign key. When empty receipts are issued without cosign; the primary proof still verifies without a secret.

SESTER_MCP_ENDPOINT.description: Remote mode URL of a real Sester-protected API. Empty = embedded local proof-chain ($0).

tools.name: pay
tools.description: Pay for a resource on an agent's behalf and return a node-cosigned receipt. Embedded mode writes a charge to the local proof-chain — no keys, no testnet, $0.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a receipt INDEPENDENTLY on the receiving side. No Sester install, no node secret: the proof is recomputed with sha256.

tools.name: balance
tools.description: Show an agent's daily spend, quota and remaining budget (embedded mode).

tools.name: history
tools.description: List proof-chain events (charge/refund) with chain head for audit.

privacy.keys: The ledger seal (SESTER_MCP_SECRET) and node-cosign key stay server-side and never appear in a receipt. Verification of the primary proof needs no secret at all.
privacy.network: None in embedded mode. Remote mode (SESTER_MCP_ENDPOINT) makes one outbound x402-HMAC call to the configured endpoint only.
